title: Ngā Manuhiri Tauhou o tētahi Tāone Taiepa
intro: I tae atu tētahi rōpū ki ngā kūaha o tētahi tāone kāore anō kia mōhiotia e tōna iwi te pono. I kawea mai e rātou he karere, engari i tahuri ngā tāngata whenua ki te riri, ki te whakawehi i te tutu. Heoi, mai i tētahi wāhi kāore i whakaarohia, ka ara ake tētahi reo kotahi hei tiaki i ngā manene, ka whakatakoto i te atamira mō tētahi huringa nui o ngā kaupapa.
clues: I tomo mātou ki tētahi tāone nui, ā, i miharo te iwi ki te kore whakapono.
I titiro mai rātou ki a mātou me te whakapae, ā, ka mea mai, 'He tangata noa iho koutou pērā i a mātou.'
I whakatūpato mātou i a rātou, engari i whakaarahia e rātou he kōhatu hei whakahē i a mātou.
I oma mai tetahi tangata i te pito rawa o te tāone ki te whakaū i tō mātou pono.
I kī atu ia ki tōna iwi, 'He aha ahau te kore ai e karakia ki te Kaihanga i ahau?'
Kotahi noa te pakūnga i mutu ai te whakakahore a te tāone, ā, kātahi ka noho te wāngu ki te wāhi i tawai ai rātou i mua.

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
